party_changed_from_first_pass.reason: Chronology, not difficulty. The first-pass party used MAGEARNA (legendary_sign:RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F) and WHIMSICOTT (Cottonee's only source is wild:VerdanturfMeadow). Devon Corp's stairs are blocked until FLAG_RETURNED_DEVON_GOODS (data/maps/RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F/scripts.inc), which is set after Rusturf Tunnel in C08/C09, and Verdanturf is C20 at cap 30. Neither is holdable by a player standing in Rustboro Gym before the Stone Badge.

attempts.narrative: Cloyster and Reuniclus led. Josh withdrew a full-HP Glimmet on turn 1 and let Dwebble absorb the five-hit Icicle Spear; Reuniclus's Focus Blast put Nosepass to 14/50. Turn 2 Nosepass Protected a lethal Icicle Spear while Dwebble traded itself for Cloyster. Shaymin came in and was killed by the authored Acid Spray relay - Glimmet dropped its Sp. Def two stages and Nosepass's Power Gem finished it the same turn - while Reuniclus removed Glimmet. Ludicolo's spread Surf then cleared Geodude, and on turn 5 Josh withdrew the 14/50 Nosepass into a full-HP Naclstack, which walked straight into the same Surf and died without ever making a decision. Onix Taunted Reuniclus (denying Recover) and fell to Psychic behind a spent Sturdy. Giga Drain finished the returning Nosepass. Two player faints, six opponent faints.

strategy_checks.check: Acid Spray is used only when a subsequent special attack benefits, and never through Poison immunity
strategy_checks.evidence: r1 turn 3: Glimmet chose Acid Spray into Shaymin (a Grass body, not Poison-immune, so the drop was legal), Shaymin's Sp. Def harshly fell, and Nosepass's Power Gem on the same turn - after the drop - knocked Shaymin out. This is exactly the authored relay and the first pass never got to see it.

strategy_checks.check: Onix offers Taunt, Rock Tomb and Defense-powered Body Press
strategy_checks.evidence: r1 turn 5: Onix entered and chose Taunt into Reuniclus, which was at 49/67 holding Recover and Protect. The state after the turn shows both moves legal=false with MOVE_LIMITATION_DISABLED/TORMENTED. Real payoff: Reuniclus could not heal or guard for the rest of the fight. The first pass recorded this branch as unobserved.

strategy_checks.check: Toxic Debris scatters Toxic Spikes on a qualifying physical hit
strategy_checks.evidence: No player member landed a physical contact hit on Glimmet this run (Icicle Spear went into Dwebble, Earth Power and Psychic are special), and no Toxic Spikes message appeared and no switch-in was poisoned. The requirement was respected.

strategy_checks.check: Sturdy cannot promise survival against two attacks
strategy_checks.evidence: r1 turn 5: Onix endured Surf at 1 HP through Sturdy and died to Reuniclus's Psychic in the same turn. Glimmet's Focus Sash behaved the same way on turn 3 (Earth Power, then Psychic).

strategy_checks.check: Dwebble uses Shell Smash only with a surviving useful follow-up; White Herb only when the drops trigger
strategy_checks.evidence: Dwebble entered on turn 1 already at 19/49 from Icicle Spear and correctly chose X-Scissor rather than setting up into a losing board. It died holding an unconsumed White Herb, which is correct - no defensive drop ever fired.

strategy_checks.check: Galvanize converts Geodude-Alola's Double-Edge into an Electric attack
strategy_checks.evidence: r1 turn 4: Double-Edge into Reuniclus (pure Psychic; Normal and Electric are both neutral there, so this is weaker evidence than the first pass's Cloyster hit) - the first pass already confirmed the conversion super-effectively. No contrary evidence.

strategy_checks.check: Naclstack resists eligible status plans (Purifying Salt) and uses Salt Cure's residual threat with purposeful recovery
strategy_checks.result: NOT OBSERVED - could not be re-tested
strategy_checks.evidence: This is the defect the rerun was commissioned for. Naclstack was sent in on turn 5 as a mid-turn replacement and was knocked out by Ludicolo's spread Surf before its first decision point. It made zero choices, so the empty-consecutive-Protect pattern from the first pass was neither reproduced nor cleared. It still needs a run in which Naclstack survives to choose. See AI defects.
No Steel player member was ever on the field beside Nosepass this run (Lucario stayed in reserve), so the first pass's asymmetric may_switch observation could not be re-checked.

protect_ledger.payoff: real - at 14/50 it blocked Cloyster's Icicle Spear, which was lethal at 2x through five hits
real - at 14/50 it blocked Ludicolo's spread Surf (2x, lethal) and then also the Focus Blast that redirected onto it after Geodude fainted. Two blocked attacks in one turn

protect_note: No empty guard on Josh's side this run, and no consecutive Protect at all. Both Protects were forced, correct and lethal-blocking. That is a behavioural improvement over the first pass, but it is not evidence that the Naclstack defect is fixed, because Naclstack never chose an action.

ai_defects.board: Glimmet at 44/44 (Focus Sash, Toxic Debris) beside Nosepass at 50/50, against Cloyster and Reuniclus on their first turn
ai_defects.chosen: Withdrew the healthy, unthreatened Glimmet and sent Dwebble, which ate the five-hit Icicle Spear for 30 of 49
ai_defects.better: Attack. Glimmet held a Focus Sash and could not have been removed in one turn, so the pivot bought nothing that the Sash was not already buying, and it spent a full-HP Dwebble's bulk to do it.
ai_defects.note: The main agent's change is described as charging healthy turn-one switches. A healthy turn-one switch still happened here. It is priced, not forbidden, so this is an observation about the price rather than a hard illegality - but it is the same shape as the Lilith and Takao defect and it recurred on the new ROM.

ai_defects.board: Nosepass at 14/50 beside Onix at 52/52; Naclstack at 50/50 in reserve
ai_defects.chosen: Withdrew Nosepass and sent the full-HP Naclstack, which was immediately knocked out by the spread Surf that would otherwise have finished the 14 HP Nosepass
ai_defects.better: Keep Nosepass in, or pivot to a body that is not 2x weak to Water. The trade spent a healthy 50 HP member to preserve 14 HP on a damaged one, and it handed the player a free knockout.
ai_defects.note: The AI cannot read my target, so this is a forecast error rather than an illegal choice; but the switch-in choice itself ignored that every remaining member of Josh's team is 2x weak to the Water attack that had just been fired on the previous turn.

level_changes: none. Won on the first attempt but with two player faints out of six against six opponent faints, which is the brief's 'won after a real fight' band. Keep the authored offsets (3/4/5/4/1/4). The main agent authored no level change for E0027 between the passes and the band does not call for one now.
cooler_note: Unchanged from the first pass, and this run sharpened the point. Naclstack has now failed to contribute in two runs for two different reasons - last-slot deployment then an instant spread knockout - and its Salt Cure/Recover pair has still never been seen. The suggestion stands: deploy Naclstack beside Onix, whose Taunt (which did fire this time, and well) creates exactly the slow grindy turns Salt Cure is written for. The Acid Spray relay firing this run is the fight's best moment and is worth protecting in any future edit.

evidence.scope: Synthetic headless benchmark through scripts/playthrough/battle_driver.py. Not earned campaign play.
